baseline.hypothesis: The shipped model, as the comparison every other row is read against.
baseline.name: baseline

contracts_x_moved.hypothesis: A settled veteran's prior volume already encodes what his team thinks of him, but a mover's describes a job he no longer has. Contract value should help on changed-teams rows and nowhere else, which is why it enters interacted rather than as a main effect.
contracts_x_moved.name: contracts_x_moved
contracts_x_moved.note: Changed teams is plan 18's worst thin-evidence flag at +32% median rank error. Probed positive at all four positions on that subpopulation and a wash or worse on the full one.
contracts_x_moved.source: OverTheCap via nflreadr::load_contracts (98.1% of rostered players)
contracts_x_moved.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain +0.0007 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

efficiency_fitted_baseline.hypothesis: The efficiency head has never had a feature: it shrinks every player toward his position's pooled rate. Replacing that constant with a rate fitted on route depth, separation and goal-line role should improve the rates most for the players with least opportunity of their own, who are exactly the ones the constant serves worst.
efficiency_fitted_baseline.name: efficiency_fitted_baseline
efficiency_fitted_baseline.note: Probed before building: WR catch rate holdout R-squared 0.083 to 0.136, TE yards-per-target 0.015 to 0.113. NGS covers only 35-75% of the relevant population, so the fallback to the positional constant carries a lot of rows.
efficiency_fitted_baseline.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain +0.0003 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

efficiency_no_ngs_gate.hypothesis: The first efficiency run was damped by its own coverage, and the diagnostic says so precisely: the fitted prior reached 95.6% of the players who give a prior 6.8% weight and 0.4% of those who give it 88.9%, because NGS's qualifying threshold is a volume threshold and credibility weight is inversely proportional to volume. The touchdown-rate baselines did not have to inherit that: they are built on play-by-play field position, which has no threshold, and only the stray ngs_adot term gated them. Dropping it should let those two rates reach the low-volume players where a prior actually decides the number.
efficiency_no_ngs_gate.name: efficiency_no_ngs_gate
efficiency_no_ngs_gate.note: ngs_adot's coefficients in the touchdown fits were +0.0016 and +0.0010 -- near nothing, bought at the cost of most of the coverage. A cheap term that gates an expensive one.
efficiency_no_ngs_gate.source: red-zone play-by-play only (79-96% coverage), NGS for the yardage rates as before
efficiency_no_ngs_gate.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain +0.0004 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

red_zone_role_volume.hypothesis: Goal-line work is role rather than skill, and role is the only thing that has ever moved this model. Prior-season red-zone share should predict next-season volume beyond raw volume.
red_zone_role_volume.name: red_zone_role_volume
red_zone_role_volume.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain -0.0005 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

ridge_alpha_1.hypothesis: Not a feature but the functional form. If the heads are overfitting their seven regressors, regularising them should help. Predicted beforehand to do nothing -- n runs 450 to 1,500 per position-target against seven terms, which is comfortable for OLS -- and that prediction was wrong: alpha 10 was the single largest effect measured in this plan. The sweep exists because one good point is not a result. A gain that holds across a wide range of alpha is a real bias-variance trade; a gain that spikes at one value is the test set being fitted.
ridge_alpha_1.name: ridge_alpha_1
ridge_alpha_1.note: Standardised, intercept unpenalised. Alpha is NOT tuned on these folds -- the whole curve is reported and the shape is the evidence. Selecting the best point here would be exactly the fishing the decision rule exists to prevent.
ridge_alpha_1.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain +0.0005 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

routes_volume.hypothesis: Route participation is opportunity stripped of whether the quarterback liked him. Expected to fail: probed at +0.004 to +0.014 holdout R-squared and no movement in ordering at all, because routes correlate 0.88-0.91 with targets.
routes_volume.name: routes_volume
routes_volume.note: Run despite the negative probe, because the probe omitted depth_rank and this is the test that includes it.
routes_volume.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain +0.0000 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

shrinkage_at_floor.hypothesis: Every efficiency rate shrunk to its measured credibility floor. If the shipped constants are too small, the model is keeping noise it should be discarding, and per-stat MAE should fall furthest on the rates that persist least.
shrinkage_at_floor.name: shrinkage_at_floor
shrinkage_at_floor.note: A floor, not an estimate: it assumes the true rate is perfectly stable, so drift raises it. Passing here would mean the shipped constants are too small; failing would mean the floor's assumption does more damage than the extra shrinkage buys.
shrinkage_at_floor.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain -0.0018 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

shrinkage_double.hypothesis: Every rate at twice its shipped constant -- a point between the shipped value and the floor. Included so the result is a curve rather than one point: a gain that holds from 2x to the floor is a real bias-variance trade, and one that appears only at the floor is the folds being fitted.
shrinkage_double.name: shrinkage_double
shrinkage_double.note: Same reasoning as the ridge sweep: the shape is the evidence, and picking the best point would be the fishing the rule exists to stop.
shrinkage_double.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain -0.0012 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

shrinkage_touchdowns_at_floor.hypothesis: Only the touchdown and interception rates. They are the least forecastable quantities measured (+0.189 to +0.276 year over year against +0.895 for carries per game), and the blend's one per-stat defect is a touchdown stat. If shrinkage is the answer it should show here without moving yardage at all.
shrinkage_touchdowns_at_floor.name: shrinkage_touchdowns_at_floor
shrinkage_touchdowns_at_floor.note: Scoped deliberately. `shrinkage_at_floor` moves eight rates at once and a pooled gain there would not say which did the work -- the same reason every other experiment here varies one thing.
shrinkage_touchdowns_at_floor.verdict_reason: mean within-position Spearman gain -0.0009 is below the +0.0050 the rule requires.

verdict.curve_reason: discounting healthy comparables improves their MAE by 0.53%, so the curve is fitting regression to the mean rather than injury.
verdict.hazard_reason: weekly Brier is 0.9898 of the constant base rate's, above the 0.9800 the rule requires -- the hazard is not a weekly predictor. The pooled per-body-part rate is unaffected and may still be quoted.

2025.why_partly_scored: Both scrapers overwrite their raw price file, so only the last scrape of the season survives. The markets in RECOVERABLE are scored anyway, because their old projection is an invertible function of the price alone; BOL_passingTouchdowns and every yardage market are not, because their line moves and was not archived. Per-week raw copies start now.

verdict.distribution_reason: 80% interval coverage is 0.682 on players projected above 25 points, outside [0.72, 0.88]: too narrow -- it is lying.
verdict.joint_reason: the joint draw is +2.1pp closer to nominal for depth-rank >= 2 RBs and TEs, below the 5.0pp the rule requires, so the room-level machinery does not earn its complexity and phase 1 ships alone. Entrenched starters move +0.0pp, so the effect is exactly as specific as the mechanism claims; it is the size that fails, not the direction.
verdict.relevance_reason: 12.8% of draftable players move by 12+ picks under p_top12, above the 5% the rule requires.
verdict.role_reason: role-conditional coverage is 0.680, 12.0 points from nominal against the 5 the rule allows -- so the interval is not fit to replace anything, whatever it beats.
